title: Background Jobs: Task Queues, Cron & Workers
description: Runnable background job examples: a Celery task module with retries and Beat scheduling, a BullMQ worker with retry backoff and dead-letter handling, a Spring @Scheduled service, and a Docker Compose stack wiring Redis, worker, beat, and API.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de tareas en segundo plano: módulo de tareas Celery con reintentos y programación Beat, worker BullMQ con backoff y manejo de dead-letter, servicio Spring @Scheduled y stack Docker Compose con Redis, worker, beat y API.
